meta.scope: 根仓库与文档指明的 .worktrees/ae1 开发仓库全部本地可见引用的可达提交并集；未执行 fetch，不含未提交工作树改动

commits.title: M0: scaffold engineering baseline
commits.descriptionZh: 搭建 FastAPI API、worker 与 Next.js 前端的模块化单体骨架，并落地统一配置、请求关联 ID、结构化日志、错误信封、健康/就绪端点、Alembic 首版迁移及模型、知识、追踪稳定契约。
commits.detail: 同时加入 ADR、Docker/CI 静态基线、canonical JSON 哈希与执行上下文基础组件及单元测试；M0 明确不实现认证、RAG、Agent、Tool、Approval 或评测产品。

commits.title: M0: record verification status
commits.descriptionZh: 新增 M0 验证记录，汇总 Python/Ruff、单元测试、API 健康与就绪语义、Alembic SQL、checkpoint CLI、Compose 语法和 Next.js 构建等当时检查结果。
commits.detail: 文档把已通过项与推迟到 M1/M3/M5/M8 的真实基础设施验证分开记录，避免把未运行的依赖检查算作 M0 失败。

commits.title: M0: lock project dependencies
commits.descriptionZh: 生成并提交 uv.lock 与前端 package-lock.json，固定 Python、Node 依赖解析结果，并同步 M0 验证记录中的锁定依赖检查。
commits.detail: 通过锁文件使后端同步和前端安装可重复，后续 CI 可使用 locked/frozen 安装路径。

commits.title: docs: defer infrastructure verification by milestone
commits.descriptionZh: 调整 M0 计划、README 和验证记录，将真实 PostgreSQL、Redis、Qdrant、LangGraph checkpoint 与完整 Compose 部署验证按里程碑延期登记。
commits.detail: 把延期项明确分配到 M1、M3、M5、M8，并保持 M0 的可执行验收边界不依赖当时未启动的基础设施。

commits.title: M1-A: add auth tenant RBAC schema
commits.descriptionZh: 新增 M1 身份与租户数据模型和 0002 迁移，包括用户、认证会话、Organization/Workspace 成员关系、审计日志及数据库约束，并接入配置、数据库会话和执行上下文。
commits.detail: Organization membership 与 Workspace membership 分开建模，认证主键与成员关系使用带租户边界的复合关联，为后续服务层授权提供持久化基础。

commits.title: M1-B: implement authentication sessions
commits.descriptionZh: 实现认证 API 与会话服务：Argon2 密码处理、短期访问 JWT、opaque refresh token 轮换和复用检测，以及登录、刷新和登出路由。
commits.detail: 认证依赖把请求主体转换为 PrincipalContext，会话记录只保存刷新凭据的安全摘要，并在路由层统一注入认证边界。

commits.title: M1-C: add tenant access and RBAC services
commits.descriptionZh: 新增 Organization/Workspace 访问服务、租户 API 和 RBAC 权限矩阵，实现 OWNER/ADMIN、DEVELOPER、VIEWER 的角色解析与工作区成员管理。
commits.detail: 请求从 PrincipalContext 逐步解析 OrganizationContext 和 WorkspaceExecutionContext，服务端权限检查成为后续业务路由的统一依据。

commits.title: M1-D: harden RBAC tenant boundaries and audit
commits.descriptionZh: 加固租户越权与审计边界：成员查询和写入限定当前主体所属组织/工作区，跨租户对象返回 404，并对角色变更、成员删除和最后 Owner 约束执行数据库锁保护。
commits.detail: 仓储与服务层把授权判断放在数据查询和服务事务内，同时把敏感成员操作写入审计日志。

commits.title: M1-E: add PostgreSQL integration verification
commits.descriptionZh: 新增 M1 PostgreSQL 集成测试入口和 M1 验证文档，使用真实数据库覆盖迁移、注册登录、会话轮换、租户隔离和 RBAC。
commits.detail: 测试配置拒绝以 SQLite 代替 PostgreSQL，并在测试依赖中补齐异步数据库与 HTTP 客户端组件。

commits.title: docs: clean M1 verification formatting
commits.descriptionZh: 清理 M1 验证文档的表格与命令格式，使验收记录、运行方式和结果标识更易核对。
commits.detail: 该提交只调整文档呈现，不改变 M1 代码或验收范围。

commits.title: M1-E: fix principal UUID serialization
commits.descriptionZh: 修复认证主体 UUID 的序列化问题，使认证依赖与会话响应能稳定输出字符串化标识，并更新 PostgreSQL 集成测试断言。
commits.detail: 应用层继续保留 UUID 类型，API 边界按 JSON 字符串交付，避免同一主体在不同路由出现类型不一致。

commits.title: test: verify M1 against PostgreSQL
commits.descriptionZh: 扩充真实 PostgreSQL 上的 M1 集成测试并更新验收记录，覆盖认证、租户、工作区成员与权限边界。
commits.detail: 把集成测试从入口准备推进到可执行验收，并将实跑结果写回 M1 文档；本次历史整理不声称重新执行该测试。

commits.title: feat: close M1 auth tenant rbac boundaries
commits.descriptionZh: 集中收口 M1 审查问题：完善租户成员与权限服务、跨租户 404、最后 Owner 并发保护、迁移约束、认证会话、请求关联日志及 CI/Compose 配置。
commits.detail: 同步调整 PostgreSQL 集成测试和审计记录，使授权、事务与基础设施检查在同一验收基线通过文档记录。

commits.title: docs: record M1 acceptance pass
commits.descriptionZh: 更新 M1 验收文档，记录后端单元/合约/API、Ruff、Alembic 和真实 PostgreSQL 集成测试均达到阶段通过条件。
commits.detail: 文档同时固定 M1 的租户权限与认证范围，避免后续里程碑把 Organization 与 Workspace 成员概念混用。

commits.title: feat(model-gateway): freeze provider-neutral contracts
commits.descriptionZh: 定义 provider-neutral ModelGateway 的 generate、stream、usage、cost、health、capabilities 与错误契约，并扩展 TraceSink 的安全观测接口。
commits.detail: 业务调用方只提交能力需求与执行上下文，不直接持有 provider、模型名或密钥覆盖参数；错误与流事件使用稳定类型。

commits.title: feat(model-gateway): add scoped profiles and credentials
commits.descriptionZh: 新增模型凭据与模型配置的数据库模型、0003 迁移、复合外键和 profile resolution 服务，按 WorkspaceExecutionContext 解析主模型与回退链。
commits.detail: 凭据引用和 profile 只能在同一工作区内关联，配置解析在执行前检查启用状态、能力与回退关系。

commits.title: feat(model-gateway): add LiteLLM provider adapter
commits.descriptionZh: 加入 LiteLLM adapter，支持 DeepSeek 及 OpenAI-compatible 模型调用，将 provider 请求/响应映射为 AgentHub 的生成、流式、usage 与错误契约。
commits.detail: 第三方 SDK 被隔离在 adapter 内，应用层继续依赖稳定网关接口；依赖与单元测试同步更新。

commits.title: feat(model-gateway): enforce retry and fallback boundaries
commits.descriptionZh: 实现模型调用超时、有限重试和在首个可见 token 之前的透明 fallback，并禁止出现可见 delta 后切换 provider。
commits.detail: 网关记录每次尝试结果并校验回退 profile 的身份与能力，失败路径映射为安全、可分类的 ModelGatewayError。

commits.title: feat(observability): trace model gateway safely
commits.descriptionZh: 在 ModelGateway 中接入可选 TraceSink，记录 model.generate 的 provider/model 身份、尝试、延迟、状态和用量/成本安全摘要。
commits.detail: 追踪失败保持 fail-open；请求/响应内容、凭据和原始 provider 异常不进入 span。

commits.title: feat(model-gateway): complete M2 verification
commits.descriptionZh: 完成 M2 验收：补齐网关持久化与服务测试，更新 M2 范围和验证文档，记录模型合约、adapter、回退边界和追踪的通过状态。
commits.detail: M2 文档明确不创建 Agent、RAG、Tool、Approval、model_invocations，也不引入 M3/M5 的基础设施。

commits.title: test(migrations): keep M1 integration at M1 head
commits.descriptionZh: 修正 M1 PostgreSQL 集成测试的迁移目标，使该测试固定升级到 M1 的 0002 head，而不会被后续 M2 的 0003 迁移改变语义。
commits.detail: 测试隔离各里程碑的迁移基线，减少后续新增迁移对旧里程碑验证的干扰。

commits.title: fix(model-gateway): tighten message and capability contracts
commits.descriptionZh: 收紧模型消息、能力需求和回退合约：校验消息角色/内容、能力组合、profile 映射及网关调用输入，减少 adapter 前的非法状态。
commits.detail: 同步调整 LiteLLM adapter 与单元测试，使类型约束和运行时异常保持一致。

commits.title: fix(model-gateway): enforce timeout and secret-safe errors
commits.descriptionZh: 强化模型超时与密钥安全：为每次 provider 调用应用有界超时，将异常统一映射为不含凭据或原始 traceback 的安全错误，并保持首 token 前后的回退差异。
commits.detail: adapter 与网关测试分别覆盖超时、鉴权失败和敏感错误清洗。

commits.title: fix(model-gateway): align validation and migration checks
commits.descriptionZh: 对齐 M2 的输入校验、模型/profile 持久化约束、认证与迁移检查，并更新 PostgreSQL 集成测试以覆盖复合租户关系。
commits.detail: 该收口统一 ORM 与迁移的结构定义，避免开发模型和 Alembic schema 漂移。

commits.title: ci: prepare database before alembic check
commits.descriptionZh: 调整 GitHub Actions，在 Alembic 与集成检查前先准备 PostgreSQL 数据库和服务。
commits.detail: CI 把数据库初始化与 schema 检查按正确依赖顺序执行，消除首次连接失败。

commits.title: ci: isolate PostgreSQL integration suites
commits.descriptionZh: 继续隔离 PostgreSQL 集成套件，在 CI 中分别运行 M1 与 M2 的专项测试，避免测试污染或迁移 head 相互覆盖。
commits.detail: 将通用非集成测试与数据库依赖测试分组，保留 M1、M2 各自的独立验收信号。

commits.title: docs: record M2 acceptance pass
commits.descriptionZh: 更新 M2 验收文档，记录网关 43 项单元/合约测试、Ruff、PostgreSQL migration check、全仓回归及前端构建的文档结果。
commits.detail: 验收记录明确以 2c3fee2 为代码基线并停在 ModelGateway 边界；本次只整理历史，不改写为本次重跑。

commits.title: merge: M2 model gateway
commits.descriptionZh: 将 M2 模型网关分支合并回主干，合并基线包含 provider-neutral 合约、工作区级 profile/credential、LiteLLM adapter、回退/超时与安全 trace。
commits.detail: 父提交分别为 M2 分支起点 9f43ba4 和验收提交 059e870；该 merge 本身没有文件差异，作为独立历史节点保留。

commits.title: feat: implement M3-A knowledge upload and revisions
commits.descriptionZh: 实现 M3-A 知识上传与修订 API：对文件名、媒体类型、大小与内容做安全检查，写入本地 blob，并持久化 Document、DocumentRevision 和修订生命周期。
commits.detail: 新增 0004 迁移、知识依赖注入和单元测试；上传先形成可追踪修订，后续解析、索引与检索仍由独立阶段处理。

commits.title: test: track current alembic head
commits.descriptionZh: 更新 M2 的 PostgreSQL 集成测试迁移目标，使 M2 专项仍停在 0003，而 M3 的 0004 迁移不会改变 M2 验收假设。
commits.detail: 该修改属于测试隔离，不改变知识模型或生产迁移。

commits.title: feat: implement M3-B reliable worker
commits.descriptionZh: 实现 M3-B 可靠摄取 worker：Celery/Redis 只传递 job_id，PostgreSQL IngestionJob 作为真源，通过 lease token、条件 claim 和 CAS 防重复；解析在可终止子进程内完成并生成确定性 chunk。
commits.detail: 上传后 best-effort 入队，失败由 reconciliation 补投；worker 在成功边界停在 PROCESSING/EMBEDDING，不伪造 Qdrant 索引或 READY 状态。

commits.title: feat: complete M3-C knowledge indexing
commits.descriptionZh: 实现 M3-C1 索引链路：增加 dense/sparse/reranker/vector-index 契约与 BGE、Qdrant adapter，按 EMBEDDING→INDEXING→READY 推进摄取，并用确定性 point ID 安全重放。
commits.detail: Qdrant 使用同一 collection 的 dense/sparse named vectors，upsert 等待可见并校验 schema；模型延迟加载，测试可注入确定性 fake composition。

commits.title: feat: complete M3-C hybrid retrieval
commits.descriptionZh: 实现 M3-C2 混合检索：dense 与 sparse 召回经等权 RRF 融合，再做候选重排，并在 Qdrant 查询中执行 workspace、knowledge base 与 snapshot revision 过滤。
commits.detail: RetrievalTrace 按 dense/sparse/fusion/rerank 阶段记录安全结果与延迟；知识服务不可用时返回稳定的 503 错误码。

commits.title: docs: record M3-C acceptance
commits.descriptionZh: 更新 M3-C 验收文档，记录索引、混合检索、Qdrant schema/filter、真实 BGE smoke 与 CI 检查的阶段结果。
commits.detail: 文档明确 M3-C 通过不等于 M3 总体通过，Playground、Citation QA、Snapshot 和基准仍留在后续工作包。

commits.title: fix: close M3-C review gaps
commits.descriptionZh: 依据 M3-C 审查补齐可靠性与安全缺口：生产组合始终使用真实 BGE/Qdrant，测试 fake 只能显式注入；加入确定性 point ID、Qdrant 不可用恢复、lease takeover 防旧 worker 写入和 reranker span 异常收口。
commits.detail: 同时固定 sparse IDF schema 校验、provider error 可重试分类和 CI 集成测试依赖。

commits.title: docs: record M3-C closure CI
commits.descriptionZh: 更新 M3-C 文档以记录审查修复后的 CI 与集成测试结果，区分生产真实组合和测试 fake 注入。
commits.detail: 文档将剩余 M3-D/E/F、检索基线和 M8 部署验证明确排除在本次关闭范围外。

commits.title: fix: close M3-C review details
commits.descriptionZh: 继续修正 M3-C 审查细节与索引测试，明确 embedding 可在 lease 重新取得后安全重算，并保持 PostgreSQL 事务和 Qdrant 替换顺序一致。
commits.detail: 更新 README 与验收表，消除测试覆盖和实际关闭状态之间的歧义。

commits.title: feat: add M3-D retrieval playground API

commits.title: feat: add M3-D retrieval playground UI

commits.detail: 页面包含初始、加载、空结果和安全错误状态，访问令牌只保存在当前 React state。

commits.title: fix: close M3-D playground review gaps
commits.descriptionZh: 修复 Playground 审查问题：通过 Next.js 同源代理请求 API，显式控制代理目标，修正定位符导航并补齐安全错误与构建边界。
commits.detail: 更新 README 和 M3-D 验收文档，避免 token 进入 URL、持久化存储或检索请求体。

commits.title: feat: add M3-E citation QA
commits.descriptionZh: 实现 M3-E Citation QA 服务与 “/api/v1/knowledge/query”：在具体快照上执行固定参数的混合检索，只把有界证据交给 ModelGateway，并校验 “[n]” 引用、结构化 JSON、无证据短路和 workspace 权限。
commits.detail: 模型 profile、知识库与快照均按工作区解析；跨工作区 profile 在 provider adapter 前拒绝，trace 只保留安全检索投影。

commits.title: test: close M3-E integration acceptance

commits.detail: CI 专项运行 Citation QA 集成步骤，同时维持确定性 fake 模型/检索注入，不调用公共 LLM 或下载 BGE 权重。

commits.title: docs: record M3-E closure
commits.descriptionZh: 更新 M3-E 文档，记录 API 契约、证据边界、提示注入防护、CI 运行与关闭状态，并明确尚未实现前端问答页、LATEST 解析和 M3-F。
commits.detail: 验收表把 M3-E 与 M3 总体状态分开，保留后续 Snapshot 和检索基准工作。

commits.title: ci: retry M3-E closure
commits.descriptionZh: 为重试 M3-E 的关闭门禁触发 CI，不包含任何文件树变更。
commits.detail: 该提交保留历史运行节点；其效果仅是重新触发外部工作流，不能单独视为代码修改或新功能。

commits.title: feat: implement M3-F knowledge snapshots
commits.descriptionZh: 实现 M3-F KnowledgeSnapshot：从 workspace/KB 内 READY 且 ACTIVE 的修订确定性物化快照，保存 canonical JSON SHA-256、schema/version/items，并支持具体 UUID 与 LATEST 解析。

commits.title: fix: close M3-F snapshot integrity

commits.detail: 该提交新增 0006 同文档唯一约束以及同文档、跨知识库冲突测试；未修改 API 或 snapshot service。

commits.title: fix: shorten M3-F migration revision

commits.title: docs: record M3-F acceptance

commits.descriptionZh: 补充一轮学习文档以及 RAG 公开基准、退款场景、Memory 现状和模型自适应压缩的 review，形成后续施工前的资料基线。
commits.detail: 更新 learning 与 research/review 索引，记录问题、候选方案与尚未实现项；没有修改运行时行为。

commits.title: Fix evaluation list crash and localize reader-facing frontend copy
files: docs/reviews/AgentHub-前端体验问题清单与优化方案-20261027.md
commits.descriptionZh: 修复 evaluation 列表因响应结构不兼容导致的崩溃，并统一页面、Agent 对话区和中英语言包中的 reader-facing 文案。
commits.detail: 前端 API 解析与多个页面同步调整；目标是恢复可读与稳定渲染，不涉及评测质量。

commits.title: Trim redundant controls and headings across workspace pages
commits.descriptionZh: 精简 agents、dashboard、evaluations、knowledge、runs 与 settings 页面中的重复标题、说明和控制项，并补充统一的空态/状态组件。
commits.detail: 通过 primitives 和语言包减少页面噪声，保持原有操作入口；属于产品体验修整。

commits.title: Quiet run detail header and localize version eyebrow
commits.descriptionZh: 降低 run detail 顶部信息密度并本地化 version eyebrow，使运行详情更聚焦于状态、证据和步骤。
commits.detail: 调整 run-detail header 与两类语言包；不改变 Run 数据或恢复语义。

commits.title: Document product-noise reduction round in review notes
files: docs/reviews/AgentHub-前端体验问题清单与优化方案-20261027.md
commits.descriptionZh: 在前端体验问题清单中记录本轮减少产品噪声的范围、截图与验证边界，作为后续重设计的输入。
commits.detail: 文档更新待办和完成状态，不替代浏览器回归记录。

commits.title: Add opt-in adaptive context budgets with frozen provenance
files: docs/reviews/AgentHub-模型自适应上下文与分级压缩调研方案-20261026.md
commits.descriptionZh: 加入可选的模型自适应上下文预算，将主/备模型能力交集和本地 context catalog 冻结进发布 provenance。
commits.detail: 新增 context_policy、capability metadata、publish/runtime 接入与集成测试；新策略是 opt-in，Legacy 配置继续保留。

commits.title: Add deterministic thread history planning and recovery
commits.descriptionZh: 实现确定性的 thread history 规划与恢复，新增历史快照、transcript、evidence 三类迁移，并按 token 预算选择消息。
commits.detail: history planner/runtime 在 checkpoint 恢复时复用冻结历史边界，避免只看最近 N 轮或恢复后重算；Migration 0038-0040 进入部署链。

commits.title: Add gated summary groundwork and record M4 results
commits.descriptionZh: 搭建受门禁控制的 thread summary 基础流程，新增摘要状态、来源、校验、worker 和 QMSum 实验资产，并记录 M4 初步结果。
commits.detail: 摘要由显式 policy 和 eligibility 控制，持久化来源与 checkpoint 身份；质量门未通过前不自动启用。

commits.title: Add bounded DeepSeek text token counter for research
commits.descriptionZh: 新增有界的 DeepSeek 文本 token 计数工具，供记忆/摘要研究在派发前估算输入并控制调用上限。
commits.detail: 计数器对超长文本设边界并补充单元用例；这是研究计量工具，不替代供应商账单。

commits.title: Fence summary dispatch and retain combined failure evidence
commits.descriptionZh: 在 summary 派发前增加 fencing，并保留多个失败阶段合并证据，避免失效 worker 仍发出摘要请求。
commits.detail: service 把 dispatch lease/状态检查置于模型调用前，失败时记录完整边界；防范并发重复派发。

commits.title: Validate research model token budgets before dispatch
commits.descriptionZh: 在 research runner 派发前验证模型 token 预算，发现估算或窗口不合法就停止调用，并更新共享预算与恢复缺口记录。
commits.detail: DeepSeek counter、QMSum、trial budget/client 共用预检，未知用量不被视为零。

commits.title: Cut page chrome text and compress run tool evidence into rows
commits.descriptionZh: 减少工作台页面的说明文字，并把 run 工具证据从大块 JSON 压缩为可扫描行，保留展开查看详情的能力。
commits.detail: 调整多个页面、语言包和 run evidence 展示；目标是降低页面噪声，不改变证据内容。

commits.title: Document text-reduction round in review notes
files: docs/reviews/AgentHub-前端体验问题清单与优化方案-20261027.md
commits.descriptionZh: 在 review 中记录文字压缩轮次的页面范围、截图和未覆盖交互，便于后续逐项回归。
commits.detail: 文档以本轮实际修改为证据，未宣称全站体验完成。

commits.title: Fix research summary placeholder and quiet table link colors
commits.descriptionZh: 修复 research summary 占位文本，并统一表格链接颜色，避免实验摘要误显示为空状态或链接视觉过强。
commits.detail: 更新前端页面与样式，补最小回归；只处理展示缺陷。

commits.title: Reject numeric references embedded in different values
commits.descriptionZh: 拒绝数字引用出现在不同值内部的误匹配，例如版本号或日期片段被错误识别为 citation。
commits.detail: 引用解析器加入边界/值片段校验，避免把合法正文中的数字当成证据编号。

commits.title: Document context engineering project comparisons
commits.descriptionZh: 整理上下文工程开源项目对照，记录模型预算、历史规划、摘要和缓存设计取舍，为 M2-M5 提供选型依据。
commits.detail: 文档明确借鉴范围和不照搬能力，没有改变默认策略。

commits.title: Bound numeric reference scanning overhead
commits.descriptionZh: 为数字引用扫描增加显式开销上界，防止长消息触发无界的正则/重复扫描。
commits.detail: 在保留引用正确性的前提下限制扫描范围并补性能边界测试。

commits.title: Distinguish long-term memory from thread compaction
commits.descriptionZh: 明确长期 Memory 与 thread compaction/摘要的语义差异：Memory 是显式、可治理的跨轮事实，摘要只是当前 Thread 的上下文压缩。
commits.detail: 文档与合同补充准入、默认开关和不可互推边界，避免将摘要结果写入长期记忆。

commits.title: Bind protected excerpts to reviewed thread sources
commits.descriptionZh: 把受保护原文摘录绑定到经过审阅的 thread source，使 Memory/摘要引用能追溯到冻结消息和来源身份。
commits.detail: 新增 protected excerpt/source 关联与测试，模型生成的概括不能替代原始摘录。

commits.title: Replace native selects with themed custom dropdown
commits.descriptionZh: 用统一的主题化 custom select 替换原生下拉框，覆盖键盘焦点、菜单状态与明暗主题。
commits.detail: 前端 primitives 与多个调用页面同步修改；交互回归记录需要按前端测试范围解读。

commits.title: Consolidate sidebar, add dashboard visuals, balance grids
commits.descriptionZh: 整合 sidebar 信息架构，加入 dashboard 视觉模块并平衡网格布局，减少跨页导航层级噪音。
commits.detail: 调整 shell、页面样式和首页区域；视觉内聚不等于完成全站可访问性验证。

commits.title: Guard summary dispatch boundaries and retained evidence
commits.descriptionZh: 收紧 summary dispatch 的边界并保留组合失败证据，确保模型响应只写回仍有效的任务。
commits.detail: service 在发送和写回阶段重复核验状态，测试覆盖失败与重放；未改变摘要质量门。

commits.title: Preserve QMSum trial identity and paired outcome accounting
commits.descriptionZh: 修复 QMSum 试验的 trial identity 与配对 outcome 记账，使保留/排除项在同一次比较中使用同一身份。
commits.detail: benchmark 记录每题的 phase、variant 和 outcome，防止跨 trial 串账。

commits.title: Disable the Next.js dev indicator button
commits.descriptionZh: 禁用 Next.js 默认 dev indicator，避免开发指示浮层干扰验收截图。
commits.detail: 修改 Next 配置关闭按钮；这是本地开发展示修整。

commits.title: Bound summary worker calls by their durable lease
commits.descriptionZh: 按 durable lease 限制 summary worker 调用，只有持有有效租约的作业才能请求模型。
commits.detail: worker 在派发前检查数据库租约并补测试，减少旧 worker 重复调用。

commits.title: Keep dev indicator but move it to the bottom-right
commits.descriptionZh: 保留 Next.js dev indicator 但移到右下角，使其不影响主内容区域。
commits.detail: 后续调整代替完全关闭；只改变开发工具的位置，不涉及产品功能。

commits.title: Recheck summary leases after transactional waits
commits.descriptionZh: 在事务等待后重新检查 summary lease，防止等待期间租约过期或所有权改变后仍派发。
commits.detail: service 把校验放进实际调用边界，补竞争/过期测试。

commits.title: Document context compaction and source review boundaries
commits.descriptionZh: 记录上下文压缩、来源审阅和 protected evidence 的边界，明确自动摘要不能删改受保护原话。
commits.detail: review 文档汇总 M4 策略和失败条件，为后续实现提供验收依据。

commits.title: Fence expired leases before storing summary responses
commits.descriptionZh: 在保存 summary response 前再次拒绝已过期租约，避免响应落库到失效 worker 的作业。
commits.detail: service 将 lease fencing 延伸到写回事务，测试覆盖过期窗口；减少重复/错主写入。

commits.title: Rebuild thread pages as full-height chat-first layout
commits.descriptionZh: 把 thread 页面重建为全高 chat-first 布局，提高消息区和 composer 的可用高度。
commits.detail: 调整 thread 页面结构、样式和移动适配；从视觉布局开始产品化重设计。

commits.title: Add isolated run budget reservation ledger
commits.descriptionZh: 新增独立的 Run budget reservation ledger，记录每次模型 attempt 的预留、未知与结算状态。
commits.detail: 数据库 ledger 以稳定 attempt identity 防重放，未确认用量保持占用；此切片默认尚未接入所有运行。

commits.title: Clarify meeting-level evaluation sample limits
commits.descriptionZh: 明确 meeting-level evaluation 样本限制，说明单场会议或小样本不能外推总体质量。
commits.detail: 文档修订评测分母和结论边界，没有新增代码行为。

commits.title: Redesign thread pages as immersive product-grade chat surface
commits.descriptionZh: 把 thread 页面重设计为沉浸式产品级对话界面，完善消息层级、工具状态和 composer 视觉。
commits.detail: 在 chat-first 布局上调整组件与样式，补页面回归；不是完整质量或无障碍认证。

commits.title: Bind runtime history across checkpoint recovery
commits.descriptionZh: 在 checkpoint recovery 中绑定 runtime history，使恢复后的模型输入仍引用原 frozen transcript 边界。
commits.detail: runtime graph 写入/读取 history identity，integration 测试覆盖恢复；防止重跑时重新选历史。

commits.title: Connect summary dispatch to Run budget ledger
commits.descriptionZh: 把 summary dispatch 接到 Run budget ledger，使摘要模型调用与普通运行 attempt 共用可审计预留。
commits.detail: 新增 adapter/bridge 并在派发前预留，成功后仍需供应商账单才能结算。

commits.title: Reject unbound summary checkpoints by frozen version
commits.descriptionZh: 拒绝未绑定 frozen version 的 summary checkpoint，避免恢复时使用当前配置替代原发布版本。
commits.detail: checkpoint payload 与 version hash 交叉校验，不匹配即停止；这正是不可变运行快照的落地。

commits.title: Pin validated approval checkpoint before resume
commits.descriptionZh: 在 approval resume 前锁定已验证的 checkpoint，防止并发或过期 checkpoint 覆盖已批准动作。
commits.detail: 恢复服务在事务中复核 checkpoint 身份并固定后续执行点，补审批恢复回归。

commits.title: Reject malformed model usage and stale stream totals
commits.descriptionZh: 拒绝 malformed model usage 和 stale stream totals，避免错误金额/累计值污染 Run outcome。
commits.detail: gateway 结果校验 usage 字段和流式累计边界，异常不自动归零。

commits.title: Persist blocked history boundary in graph checkpoint
commits.descriptionZh: 把被预算/策略阻断的 history boundary 持久化进 graph checkpoint，使恢复时保持同一截断决定。
commits.detail: runtime state 保存 blocked boundary 与原因，避免恢复后重新包装并改变输入。

commits.title: Unify thread list and chat into a single DeepSeek-style workbench
commits.descriptionZh: 把 thread list 与 chat 合并为单一 DeepSeek 风格 workbench，统一历史选择、消息流和输入区域。
commits.detail: 重写 workbench 组件及页面样式，并补移动响应；这是核心前端产品化重构。

commits.title: Describe cache support and stabilize replayed tool arguments
commits.descriptionZh: 说明模型 profile 的 cache capability，并稳定 replay 时工具参数的 canonical ordering。
commits.detail: 文档/contract 与参数序列化同步调整，减少缓存击穿和重放身份漂移；不代表供应商缓存一定命中。

commits.title: Align the design system with the DeepSeek Harness platform
commits.descriptionZh: 让设计系统与 DeepSeek Harness 平台对齐，统一颜色、空间、字号和组件视觉令牌。
commits.detail: 更新 tokens、shell 和页面样式；为下一轮更激进 UI 重设计建立基础。

commits.title: Bind optional Run budgets at each model attempt
commits.descriptionZh: 在每次模型 attempt 绑定可选 Run budget，使预留从 runtime graph 一路传到 gateway。
commits.detail: adapter 通过稳定 attempt identity 连接上下文，默认只有已注入 factory 的路径启用。

commits.title: Surface unknown model charges in Run outcome
commits.descriptionZh: 在 Run outcome 中显式暴露未知模型费用，不再把 provider usage 缺失显示成零成本。
commits.detail: 模型结果与投影增加 unknown charge 状态，预算账本保留占用；UI/统计需按未知处理。

commits.title: Bind summary reviews to frozen dispatch boundaries
commits.descriptionZh: 把 summary review 绑定到冻结的 dispatch 边界，确保人工审阅对应实际派发来源而非当前 thread。
commits.detail: 保存来源、版本和 protected excerpt 身份，后续发布不能引用未审阅内容。

commits.title: Record context memory acceptance and open gaps
commits.descriptionZh: 记录 context memory 的阶段验收和开放缺口，明确已通过工程项与尚未证明的模型质量。
commits.detail: 更新总验收文档和 review 索引，没有关闭剩余风险。

commits.title: Verify protected review through summary publication
commits.descriptionZh: 验证受保护来源从审阅到 summary publication 的完整链路，确保摘录和来源身份一路保留。
commits.detail: service 与 worker 测试覆盖审阅后发布；重点是一致性，不是摘要内容质量。

commits.title: Bind run budget adapters and update checkpoint regressions
commits.descriptionZh: 把 Run budget adapters 接入更多模型与 checkpoint 路径，并更新恢复/预算回归。
commits.detail: 在现有 ledger 上绑定 adapter 并补竞态用例，避免不同入口使用不同结算语义。

commits.title: Add route-scoped non-thinking request mode
commits.descriptionZh: 增加按路由限定的 non-thinking 请求模式，避免 DeepSeek 类模型把输出预算耗在默认思考过程。
commits.detail: 配置映射到 chat request，并保持主备/first-token fallback 规则；只影响显式指定路由。

commits.title: Classify safe old conversation prefixes
commits.descriptionZh: 识别安全可复用的旧对话前缀，让历史规划避免无谓截断同时不错误信任未绑定内容。
commits.detail: history planner 对旧前缀做来源和身份校验，再决定可复用范围。

commits.title: Record independent DeepSeek gateway verification
commits.descriptionZh: 记录独立 DeepSeek gateway 验证，确认请求模式、返回模型身份和错误处理在真实端点上符合预期。
commits.detail: verification 文档保留调用范围、用量和失败；不是完整质量评测。

commits.title: Recognize verified empty history evidence
commits.descriptionZh: 识别已验证的空 history evidence，使“确实没有历史”与“历史缺失/不可读”得到不同处理。
commits.detail: history runtime 引入明确 empty-evidence 状态，供恢复和投影正确解释。

commits.title: feat(agent-runtime): complete M4 summary workflow
commits.descriptionZh: 完成 M4 summary workflow，把 eligibility、source、worker、checkpoint、budget、review 和 publication 串成一条受门禁的可恢复流程。
commits.detail: 24 个文件完成端到端接线，并使摘要默认受质量门约束；工程闭环不等于摘要收益已通过。

commits.title: docs: record M4 validation and evaluation limits
commits.descriptionZh: 记录 M4 验证和评测限制，汇总真实/模拟调用、失败边界与未完成质量对照。
commits.detail: 更新 M4 文档与 review 索引，明确自动摘要仍未达到推广条件。

commits.title: feat(web): instrument-console design foundation
commits.descriptionZh: 建立 Instrument Console 的暗色设计基础，重写 tokens、base、auth、shell、pages 与 primitives 样式，并记录 UI 重设计方向。
commits.detail: 通过统一设计令牌和基础组件建立控制台视觉层；提交仅完成设计基础，业务页面随后逐步迁移。

commits.title: feat(web): vivid agent palette, simplified sidebar, chat-first workbench
commits.descriptionZh: 调整 Agent 配色和侧栏结构，建立更鲜活的品牌色系与 chat-first workbench，并同步登录/注册页。
commits.detail: 修改 tokens、auth/page/shell 样式及 app-workbench、AppShell；保留既有数据操作，主要改变信息层级与视觉。

commits.title: feat(web): collapsible sidebar and chat-surface polish
commits.descriptionZh: 加入可折叠侧栏、用户菜单和对话面细节打磨，并补充中英文标签。
commits.detail: AppShell 与 responsive/research 样式共同管理展开状态；移动端细节继续后续提交修补。

commits.title: fix(web): stop approvals crash on a bare-array response
files: docs/reviews/AgentHub-真实数据走查与审批崩溃修复-20261028.md
commits.descriptionZh: 修复 approvals 页面在 API 直接返回裸数组时的崩溃，并把审批列表、dashboard 与客户端解析统一到兼容投影。
commits.detail: approvals.ts 负责规范化响应，页面区分空态和错误；解决真实数据走查发现的渲染缺陷。

commits.title: feat(web): chat-first home composer
commits.descriptionZh: 在首页加入 chat-first composer，让用户从新会话直接开始任务，并同步工作台与语言包。
commits.detail: home page 与 app-workbench 共享输入路径；目标是把对话设为产品主入口。

commits.title: fix(web): make the conversation workbench usable on phones
commits.descriptionZh: 调整 conversation workbench 的手机布局、宽度和输入区，使消息流在窄屏仍可操作。
commits.detail: responsive 样式与 workbench 组件同步调整，并写入移动端复核记录；不代表完成所有移动浏览器。

commits.title: feat(web): make the workspace home conversation-first
commits.descriptionZh: 把 workspace 首页进一步收口为 conversation-first，删除或弱化分散入口并统一首屏结构。
commits.detail: 首页页面与语言包精简，主 composer 获得更高视觉优先级。

commits.title: fix(web): give emphasised metric cards a semantic tone
commits.descriptionZh: 为强调指标卡增加语义 tone，使成功、警告和中性指标不只靠颜色强弱表达。
commits.detail: metric-card 接受明确语义并联动 dashboard/CSS；可读性仍需主题与无障碍检查。

commits.title: fix(web): hide the dead context toggle on phones
commits.descriptionZh: 在手机宽度隐藏无实际作用的 context toggle，避免误触进入不可用状态。
commits.detail: responsive 与 workbench 组件按断点移除控件，并补审批/设置回归记录。

commits.title: feat(web): add a dismissible scrim to the mobile nav drawer
commits.descriptionZh: 给移动导航抽屉加入可关闭 scrim，点击遮罩即可退出并保留侧栏状态。
commits.detail: AppShell、shell/responsive 样式和语言包共同实现；提升小屏导航可退出性。

commits.title: fix(web): localize member roles and breadcrumb segments
commits.descriptionZh: 本地化成员角色和 breadcrumb 段名，避免设置页与导航混用英文枚举。
commits.detail: members page、breadcrumbs 和两套语言包同步补充映射，语言缺失时保留安全回退。

commits.title: fix(web): localize MCP auth type labels
commits.descriptionZh: 本地化 MCP authentication type 标签，使 MCP 工具页与中英文界面一致。
commits.detail: MCP 页面和语言包增加 TOKEN/OAUTH 等认证类型映射。

commits.title: fix(web): give the custom select a visible keyboard focus ring
commits.descriptionZh: 为自定义 select 增加清晰的键盘 focus ring，并保证打开菜单与选项焦点可见。
commits.detail: components CSS 使用统一焦点令牌，复核键盘导航；只修可见焦点，不重写 select 逻辑。

commits.title: fix(web): auto-expand the More nav section for its active route
commits.descriptionZh: 当 active route 位于 More 导航组时自动展开该组，避免当前页面入口被折叠隐藏。
commits.detail: AppShell 根据 pathname 计算展开状态并同步 shell CSS；不改变路由权限。

commits.title: feat(web): focus the composer when a conversation is empty
commits.descriptionZh: 当 conversation 为空时自动聚焦 composer，减少进入工作台后的额外点击。
commits.detail: conversation pane 在 empty state 上挂载 focus 行为，补对话链路回归。

commits.title: feat(web): land signed-in users on the conversation-first home
commits.descriptionZh: 登录用户默认落地 conversation-first home，而不是旧 dashboard 或分散工作台。
commits.detail: AppShell 的登录后导航改到首页，保持显式导航仍可进入其它模块。

commits.title: feat(web): relative timestamps in run and thread lists
commits.descriptionZh: 在 run 与 thread 列表中显示本地化相对时间，并让格式化 helper 随 locale/time zone 更新。
commits.detail: format/provider 与列表组件共享相对时间函数，避免每页自行拼接英文。

commits.title: fix(web): localize the experiment split label
commits.descriptionZh: 本地化 experiment split 标签，补齐中英文实验详情枚举。
commits.detail: experiments page 与语言包增加 split 映射；仅修正展示。

commits.title: fix(web): fix the pricing snapshot table layout
commits.descriptionZh: 修复 pricing snapshot 表在窄容器中的列宽、换行和横向溢出。
commits.detail: pricing page 调整表格结构与样式，保留字段完整显示；按布局修复记录验证。

commits.title: fix(web): localize tool detail enums and dedupe the playground crumb
commits.descriptionZh: 本地化 tool detail 枚举并去除 playground 重复 breadcrumb，使详情页标题路径更清楚。
commits.detail: 工具详情和 playground 客户端共用现有 i18n，不改 API 数据。

commits.title: fix(web): localize LATEST/PINNED tokens in agent hints
commits.descriptionZh: 本地化 agent hint 中的 LATEST/PINNED token，避免知识绑定模式在中文界面露英文。
commits.detail: zh-CN 标签表和 agent hint 展示同步；保留 enum 值本身不变。

commits.title: docs(web): record the full frontend regression pass
commits.descriptionZh: 记录前端全站回归的页面、截图和问题关闭情况，确认对话工作台、仪表盘、设置与评测页可用。
commits.detail: review 文档汇总本轮回归证据，但不把人工抽查扩张成完整可访问性/跨浏览器认证。

commits.title: feat(context): validate isolated summary execution
commits.descriptionZh: 让 isolated summary execution 通过实验 permit 运行，增加 DeepSeek summary runner、local memory pilot 和 runtime truncation 测试。
commits.detail: 实验适配器只能绑定隔离数据库、版本与 Run；生产 composition 不创建该 permit，摘要仍受门禁。

commits.title: docs: record real summary evaluation results
commits.descriptionZh: 记录真实 summary 评测的输入、结果、失败和审阅边界，为 M4 决策提供逐次证据。
commits.detail: 更新 audit/review 文件，区分真实模型调用与脚本评分，不据此宣称摘要总体收益。

commits.title: feat(context): finalize M4 untruncated thread run, M5 cache live audit, and M2-M5 acceptance reports
commits.descriptionZh: 完成 M4 未截断 thread run、M5 隐式 cache live audit 与 M2-M5 总验收材料，并把实验预算和 evidence 固化。
commits.detail: 更新 benchmark runner 与多份验收文档；cache 只做观测，不以命中结果扣减预算或证明质量。

commits.title: test(summary): supply default policy_spec in claimed job fixture for checkpoint reload tests
commits.descriptionZh: 为 summary checkpoint reload 测试的 claimed job fixture 补默认 policy_spec，避免缺失字段掩盖真实恢复行为。
commits.detail: 仅调整测试夹具，使旧测试按当前 summary policy 合同运行。

commits.title: feat(context): support per-agent configurable thresholds, presets, and runtime controls
commits.descriptionZh: 支持 per-agent context thresholds、presets 和 runtime controls，将主备窗口比例、目标/软/硬阈值解析进发布 spec。
commits.detail: schema、context_policy、history planner/runtime 同步接收自定义参数；默认预设保持兼容，配置经发布后冻结。

commits.title: docs(learning): add Context & Memory M1-M5 development retrospective and architecture guide
commits.descriptionZh: 补充 Context & Memory M1-M5 开发复盘与架构说明，记录预算数学、摘要状态机、失败经验和采用/未采用决定。
commits.detail: 新增 learning 14/15 并更新导航；内容是对历史证据的事后整理，不新增运行能力。

commits.title: merge: integrate frontend productization workbench into RAG & learning baseline
commits.descriptionZh: 合并前端产品化 workbench 到 RAG 与 learning 基线，使前端重设计和知识研究位于同一主线祖先。
commits.detail: 这是多父集成提交，只承担分支汇合；不把独立验收结果自动合并成额外能力。

commits.title: merge: integrate Context & Memory M1-M5 and configurable policy with frontend & RAG baseline
commits.descriptionZh: 合并 Context & Memory M1-M5 与可配置 policy 分支到前端/RAG 基线，形成后续全量审阅的统一候选。
commits.detail: 这是多父 merge，连接记忆、前端和研究三条已完成分支；仍需后续 review 修复验证。

commits.title: test(summary): skip local tokenizer-dependent test when offline asset is absent
commits.descriptionZh: 让依赖本地 tokenizer 离线资产的 summary 测试在资源缺失时跳过，保持 CI/离线环境可解释。
commits.detail: 为 test 增加资产条件；业务 tokenizer 行为不变。

commits.title: docs(review): record full review report for RAG Wiki and context baseline (20261101)
commits.descriptionZh: 记录 RAG、Wiki 与 Context 的统一全量审阅，列出 P0/P1 问题、实际测试、真实阿里云调用和未覆盖范围。
commits.detail: review 先建立待修基线，不是验收通过；后续提交逐项修复并追加复核章节。

commits.title: fix(runtime): prepare without summary policy and summary lease error mapping
commits.descriptionZh: 修复 runtime 在没有 summary policy 时仍能 prepare，并把 summary lease 错误映射成 AgentHub 稳定错误码。
commits.detail: 调整 schema、context policy、planner、graph、service 与测试；避免摘要关闭时阻断普通运行。

commits.title: fix(wiki): accept insufficient evidence responses that include citations
commits.descriptionZh: 允许 Wiki 的 insufficient-evidence 回答同时携带 citations，恢复真实模型常见的“证据不足但引用可核查”响应。
commits.detail: answer 解析只放宽该合法组合，仍拒绝无来源或不支持引用。

commits.title: fix(gateway): normalize 400 response_format unsupported errors to MODEL_CAPABILITY_MISMATCH
commits.descriptionZh: 把 provider 对 response_format 不支持的 HTTP 400 归一为 MODEL_CAPABILITY_MISMATCH，而非笼统无效响应。
commits.detail: LiteLLM adapter 检查错误体并映射稳定错误；调用方可以据此降级或拒绝，而不自动静默重试。

commits.title: fix(wiki): fix lock duration, credential leak, telemetry loss, deduplication, and page matching
commits.descriptionZh: 修复 Wiki 查询锁时长、compiler spec 凭据泄漏、失败 telemetry 覆盖、query_wiki 按 chunk 重复丢失和页面词面误匹配。
commits.detail: API、worker、publish、tool 和 wiki service 多处联动，补绑定与查询测试；这是审阅发现的中高风险修复。

commits.title: fix(tests): resolve test infrastructure issues (M-10)
commits.descriptionZh: 修复 M-10 指出的测试基础设施问题，包括硬编码地址、陈旧断言和可能挂起的集成用例。
commits.detail: 修改 streaming budget、run budget、summary migration 等集成测试，使失败能反映业务而非环境。

commits.title: fix(wiki,tests): resolve review feedback on lock window, telemetry, secret redaction, and test fixtures
commits.descriptionZh: 按全量审阅反馈再次修复 Wiki 锁窗口、telemetry、secret redaction 和相关测试夹具，并更新复核记录。
commits.detail: 多份 integration fixture 与 wiki service/worker 同步调整，追加 d9e0bf8 复核章节。

commits.title: fix(tests): complete m3e fixture, clear lint debt, and assert the install fence lock
commits.descriptionZh: 收尾 M3-E fixture、清理 lint 债务并断言 install fence lock，完成测试侧一致性修复。
commits.detail: 覆盖 citation QA、summary security、review manifest、sync E2E 与 wiki worker；业务缺陷已在上一提交处理。

commits.title: test(history): assert the summary-enabled blocked-plan contract
commits.descriptionZh: 补 summary-enabled 场景下空阻断计划的合同断言，证明发布 policy 与历史 planner 在边界上采用同一语义。
commits.detail: 更新 review 文档和 history integration；测试确认 blocked plan 可复现，不声称所有恢复故障已覆盖。

commits.title: docs: add agent evaluation research report and integration plan

groups.title: Qdrant索引与混合检索
groups.summary: 完成生产模型适配、确定性索引、dense+sparse 融合、rerank 及知识检索审查收口。
groups.method: 摄取阶段调用 lazy BGE adapters，将 dense/sparse named vectors 写入 Qdrant；检索执行 snapshot/workspace/KB filter，RRF 融合后 rerank，并以阶段化 trace 暴露安全延迟和结果。
changes: 增加 DenseEmbedder、SparseEncoder、Reranker、VectorIndex 契约与 BGE/Qdrant adapters。
以确定性 point ID、wait=true upsert 和 schema 校验保证重放与 visible write。
实现 Dense Top30 + Sparse Top30 + RRF Top20 + Rerank Top6。
修复 Qdrant 恢复、stale lease、reranker span、真实/fake composition 和 PyTorch 锁文件问题。
groups.benefit: 知识修订可重复重建索引，旧 worker 不会污染可见集合；检索结果受租户与快照修订范围约束。
groups.limitations: 模型 smoke 和 PostgreSQL/Qdrant 集成属于历史文档结果；M3 总体仍依赖 Playground、QA、Snapshot 和 benchmark。本次未重跑。

children.title: 新增 RetrievalStrategy 枚举与 AgentVersion retrieval_config；DENSE 只走 dense，HYBRID 走 dense+sparse+RRF，HYBRID_RERANK 再执行 rerank，并让 search_knowledge 从冻结版本读取策略。
实现不可变 ablation 分析：比较两个 AgentVersion 的 canonical persisted spec，分类 PROMPT/MODEL/RETRIEVAL/MULTI_FACTOR/NO_CHANGE，规范化有效知识快照身份，并持久化 factor path/hash 与 analysis hash。

# M0 — Engineering Baseline + Semantics Freeze

## Scope

M0 establishes the repository, API factory/lifespan, configuration, request and trace IDs,
structured JSON logs, error envelope, health endpoints, migration boundary, checkpoint
bootstrap boundary and stable contracts for ModelGateway, KnowledgeRetriever and TraceSink.
Infrastructure configuration and deployment entrypoints are present, but runtime dependency
verification is intentionally deferred.

## Explicit non-goals

No authentication, tenant CRUD, Agent runtime, RAG pipeline, Tool runtime, Approval runtime
or evaluation product is implemented in M0.

## M0 blocking acceptance

```text
[ ] fresh clone and .env setup
[ ] uv sync and lockfile
[ ] pytest
[ ] ruff check
[ ] frontend npm build
[ ] GitHub Actions
[ ] Alembic / checkpoint bootstrap code, ADR and script static checks
```

Docker startup and real PostgresSaver bootstrap are not blocking M0 acceptance.

## Deferred infrastructure verification

| Verification | Deferred to |
|---|---|
| Real PostgreSQL + Alembic migration and Auth/Tenant/RBAC integration tests | M1 |
| Real PostgreSQL + Redis + Qdrant dependency smoke test | M3 |
| Real LangGraph PostgreSQL checkpoint bootstrap and API-restart resume | M5 |
| Docker build and complete Docker Compose deployment | M8 |

These are intentionally deferred infrastructure checks, not M0 failures.

# M2 — ModelGateway + Capability Contract

## 当前状态

M2-A 至 M2-F 已在 `m2/model-gateway` 完成实现。验收基线提交 `2c3fee2` 的 GitHub
Actions 已通过，本阶段正式标记为 `PASS`。本阶段严格停在 ModelGateway 边界，不进入 M3。

## 已实现范围

- provider-neutral 的 generate/stream/usage/cost/health/capabilities 合约；
- `provider_credentials`、`model_profiles` 与 Alembic migration `0003`；
- 显式 `WorkspaceExecutionContext` 查询和数据库复合外键，确保 credential/profile/fallback 的
  workspace 隔离；
- DeepSeek 与 OpenAI-compatible 的 LiteLLM provider adapter；
- timeout、有限 retry，以及首个可见 token 之前的 fallback；首个可见 delta 之后禁止透明切换；

- 不创建 Agent、RAG、Tool Runtime、Approval 或业务 Run；
- 不创建 `model_invocations` 表或正式业务调用持久化；
- 不增加 Redis/Qdrant 依赖，也不要求本地 Docker；
- 不修改 M3-M8 的业务 scope；
- 不提前实现 M5 的 LangGraph PostgreSQL checkpoint bootstrap。

# M3-B — Reliable Worker

## 当前范围

M3-B 只负责把 M3-A 的上传记录可靠地交给可重试、可回收的 worker，并完成解析与
确定性分块。`IngestionJob` 是 PostgreSQL source of truth；Redis/Celery 只承担消息传输。

- 上传事务提交后 best-effort enqueue；enqueue 失败仍返回已持久化的 `202`，由 reconciliation
  扫描补投递；
- Celery payload 只有 `job_id`，worker 使用独立数据库 session；
- PENDING / 过期 PROCESSING 通过随机 lease token 和条件更新竞争 claim；旧 worker 的
  stage、chunk、失败写入必须被 token 与 lease fence 拒绝；
- PDF/TXT/MD 通过 provider-neutral `DocumentParser` 解析，解析在可终止子进程中执行；
- chunk 文本、locator、content hash 与 `chunk_id` 均可重复计算，PostgreSQL upsert 可安全处理
  duplicate delivery；
- 成功边界是 `PROCESSING + EMBEDDING`，此时不伪造 embedding、Qdrant indexing、READY 或
  SUCCEEDED。

## M3-B 不做

- 不启动或接入 Qdrant；
- 不实现 dense/sparse embedding、RRF、rerank、retrieval API；这些属于 M3-C 及以后；
- 不修改 M1/M2 业务 scope。

## 验收记录

| 项目 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| parser/chunker/queue unit tests | PASS（7 passed） |
| Ruff | PASS |

# M3-D — Retrieval Playground

## Scope

M3-D exposes the existing M3-C snapshot-scoped hybrid retriever through a developer-facing
retrieval debug API and a minimal web playground. It does not add answer generation, chat,
query rewrite, Citation QA, snapshot creation, or `LATEST` resolution.

## Backend

`POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/knowledge-bases/{knowledge_base_id}/retrieval/playground`

The request requires a concrete `knowledge_snapshot_id` and accepts bounded dense, sparse,
candidate, and final top-k values. `final_top_k` cannot exceed `candidate_top_k`.

The response contains:

- final evidence with document, revision, locator, retrieval/rerank scores, and a 1,000-character
  maximum snippet;
- `dense`, `sparse`, `fused`, and `rerank` stages with latency and safe result projections;
- snapshot and total latency.

Trace stage metadata is enriched with one workspace/knowledge-base/snapshot-scoped PostgreSQL
query. Provider objects, vectors, point IDs, paths, raw SQL, and raw provider exceptions are not
returned.

Production API composition uses real BGE and Qdrant adapters. Tests inject deterministic fake
retrieval components explicitly. The endpoint retains the M1 WorkspaceExecutionContext and
`knowledge_run` permission boundary.

## Frontend

The page is available at `/knowledge/playground`. It provides workspace, knowledge base,
concrete snapshot, query, and bounded top-k inputs, followed by:

- snapshot / total latency / final evidence summary;
- Dense / Sparse / Fused / Rerank stage cards;
- locator and revision display;
- bounded final evidence snippets;
- initial, loading, empty, and safe error states.

The developer Playground requires an explicit Bearer access token in a password input. The token
is held only in current React state, is not persisted to localStorage or cookies, and never enters
the URL or retrieval request body. The page does not implement a complete Auth UI; the backend
remains responsible for real authentication and workspace permission checks.

By default, browser requests use the relative `/api/...` path and Next.js same-origin proxy.
The server-only `AGENTHUB_API_PROXY_TARGET` controls the FastAPI destination and defaults to
`http://127.0.0.1:8000`. An explicit `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL` remains available for environments
that intentionally use a directly configured API base.

## Verification

- M3-D API unit tests use explicit fake retrieval components and cover limits, concrete snapshot
  validation, tenant/snapshot scoping, permission denial, safe provider errors, trace stages,
  locator/revision enrichment, and bounded snippets.
- Frontend verification is `npm ci --no-audit --no-fund` and `npm run build`.
- M3-E Citation QA has not started.
- M3-F Snapshot lifecycle / `LATEST` resolution has not started.
- M3 overall is not yet PASS until the milestone acceptance checks and CI are recorded.

# M3-E — Citation QA

## Scope

M3-E adds the API-first, evidence-grounded Citation QA path. It does not add a frontend QA
page, snapshot creation, `LATEST` resolution, query rewriting, or M3-F functionality.

## API and tenant boundary

`POST /api/v1/knowledge/query` accepts:

- `workspace_id`
- `knowledge_base_id`
- concrete `knowledge_snapshot_id` (a UUID; `LATEST` is not accepted in M3-E)
- `model_profile_id`
- `query` bounded to 1–4,000 characters

The request requires the existing `knowledge_run` permission. The workspace context is resolved
from the authenticated principal through `TenantService.get_workspace_access`; client-supplied
workspace fields do not construct or override authorization context. Knowledge base, snapshot,
and model profile access remains workspace-scoped.

## Citation QA contract

The independent `CitationQaService` reuses `HybridKnowledgeRetriever.retrieve_with_trace` with
the fixed M3-C limits (30 dense / 30 sparse / 20 fused candidates / 6 final reranked evidence).
Evidence is numbered in rerank order and bounded by `knowledge_qa_max_evidence_chars` (16,000 by
default). Citation excerpts are capped at 1,000 characters.

The service sends only the selected evidence to M2 `ModelGateway.generate`. The system prompt
marks evidence as untrusted reference data, rejects embedded instructions and world knowledge,
requires the answer language to follow the query, and requires `[n]` support for factual claims.
The requested strict structured output is:

```json
{"answer":"...","citation_ids":[1],"insufficient_evidence":false}
```

Model output validation rejects malformed JSON, unknown citation IDs, invalid markers, citation
set mismatches, missing citations for non-insufficient answers, and citations on insufficient
answers. Invalid output maps to `CITATION_QA_INVALID_MODEL_OUTPUT` without exposing provider
details. Configuration errors are safe 4xx responses; provider/timeout failures are safe 503
responses.

When a concrete snapshot has no evidence, the gateway is not called. The deterministic answer is
`Insufficient evidence to answer from the selected knowledge snapshot.` with no citations and the
retrieval trace preserved.

## Safety and trace

The response exposes provider-neutral citations and retrieval trace stages only. It does not
return vectors, Qdrant point IDs, provider credentials, absolute blob paths, raw model errors,
or full document text in the trace. Production composition uses the real SQLAlchemy model
gateway and real retrieval adapters; tests inject deterministic retrieval components and an
explicit fake model gateway.

## Verification and acceptance

- Unit/API tests cover no-evidence short circuit, citation validation, prompt-injection
  separation, evidence and excerpt bounds, permissions, snapshot scope, safe model errors, and
  response redaction.
- Integration coverage uses real PostgreSQL tenant/auth/snapshot access and real Qdrant with
  deterministic fake embedding/sparse/rerank components and an explicit fake model gateway.
- Required checks: locked Ruff, Alembic upgrade/check, non-integration pytest, M3-E PostgreSQL /
  Qdrant integration, `git diff --check`, and frontend install/build.
- GitHub Actions continues to use PostgreSQL, Redis, Qdrant, and Celery without downloading BGE
  weights or calling a public LLM.

Final closure verification:

- GitHub Actions run `35319858669` — [CI run](https://github.com/lijihao-0804/AgentHub/actions/runs/35319858669)
- backend job: PASS
- frontend job: PASS
- dedicated `tests/integration/test_m3e_citation_qa.py` step: PASS
- real PostgreSQL/Qdrant integration cases: PASS, including cross-workspace model-profile
  rejection before provider adapter invocation

M3-E acceptance closure is complete. M3 overall is not marked PASS; M3-F Snapshot lifecycle /
`LATEST` resolution has not started.

# M3-F — Knowledge Snapshot

Status: PASS. M4 has not started.

## Scope

M3-F materializes a provider-neutral knowledge snapshot for one workspace and knowledge base.
The current set contains only document revisions that are both `READY` and `ACTIVE`. Items are
ordered deterministically by document ID, revision number, and revision ID. A conflicting pair
of current revisions for one document fails safely instead of producing an ambiguous snapshot.
An empty knowledge base is a valid snapshot.

The canonical payload is schema version 1, the knowledge-base ID, and the stable document/revision
items. Its SHA-256 is produced by the existing `canonical_json_hash` helper. Repeating the same
materialization is idempotent through the scoped `(workspace_id, knowledge_base_id, content_hash)`
unique key; a concurrent insert is re-read and never silently discarded.

## Runtime contract and API

`KnowledgeSnapshotService` provides concrete UUID resolution and the reusable `LATEST` selector.
It returns `ResolvedKnowledgeSnapshot` with the effective snapshot ID, content hash, schema
version, item count, and creation time. Concrete resolution is scoped to both workspace and
knowledge base, and historical snapshots remain resolvable after their source revisions are
retired.

The API endpoint is:

`POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/knowledge-bases/{knowledge_base_id}/snapshots`

It requires the existing `knowledge_run` permission and returns the snapshot identity and item
count. M3-D and M3-E continue to require concrete snapshot UUIDs; only M3-F introduces the
reusable `LATEST` resolution helper.

## Database integrity

Snapshot and snapshot-item creation occur in one transaction. Migration
`0005_m3f_snapshot_integrity` adds the composite workspace/knowledge-base/document/revision
foreign keys, and migration `0006_m3f_snapshot_document_integrity` freezes one revision per
document in each snapshot with `UNIQUE (workspace_id, snapshot_id, document_id)`. Cross-scope,
document/revision, and same-document duplicate revision mismatches are rejected by PostgreSQL.

## Verification

The M3-F integration suite covers API materialization and reuse, lifecycle filtering, empty
snapshots, historical resolution, duplicate-current conflict, concurrent idempotency, concurrent
ingestion consistency, cross-scope lookup, composite foreign-key enforcement, same-document
duplicate revision rejection, and cross-knowledge-base SnapshotItem rejection. CI runs this
suite after the existing M3-E integration step against the same PostgreSQL, Redis, Qdrant, and
Celery services; it does not download BGE weights or call a public LLM.

Acceptance requires locked Ruff, Alembic upgrade/check, non-integration pytest, the dedicated
M3-F PostgreSQL integration step, diff checks, and the frontend install/build. The final CI run,
backend/frontend status, and commit are recorded here after push.

## Final acceptance

- implementation commit: `09ef846`
- final migration-fix commit: `eeaf8a0`
- GitHub Actions #45: [final closure run](https://github.com/lijihao-0804/AgentHub/actions/runs/35328604062)
- backend: PASS
- frontend: PASS
- M3-F integration: PASS, 10 passed
- local PostgreSQL Alembic upgrade/check: PASS on a fresh `agenthub_m3f_closure` database
- local non-integration pytest: PASS, 125 passed / 37 deselected
- local Ruff and diff check: PASS
- local frontend install/build: PASS

# M4-A — Agent Draft / AgentVersion / Publish

Status: PASS — closure verified in GitHub Actions run #55.

M4-A establishes the immutable publication boundary only. It does not execute an Agent, call a
model provider, execute a Tool, start LangGraph, stream output, or implement Approval.

## Scope

- `agents` stores the workspace-scoped mutable Draft.
- `agent_versions` stores immutable resolved runtime snapshots.
- `agent_knowledge_bindings` stores Draft knowledge selectors.
- `tools`, `tool_revisions` and `agent_tools` persist the minimum binding state needed to freeze
  ToolRevision identity; no Tool Runtime is implemented.
- `AgentPublishService` resolves the existing M2 ModelProfile chain, validates required
  capabilities, resolves concrete Knowledge Snapshots, resolves concrete ToolRevisions, builds
  the provider-neutral `resolved_spec`, and persists its canonical SHA-256 hash.

## Frozen publication contract

`resolved_spec` contains:

- `spec_schema_version`;
- model provider/model/timeout/retry/fallback/capabilities and credential references without
  credential secrets;
- system prompt and prompt version;
- retrieval configuration plus concrete snapshot IDs and content hashes;
- ToolRevision IDs, spec hashes and safe effect/risk/approval projections;
- runtime limits and context budget.

Published versions use a concrete `PINNED` snapshot projection. Draft `LATEST` selectors, when
used, are resolved before the immutable spec is written; `LATEST` is never persisted in the
published retrieval projection.

LATEST publication has an explicit transaction boundary: required LATEST selectors are first
materialized through the existing Knowledge Snapshot service, whose commit is allowed to finish
that materialization transaction. Publish then re-enters a fresh transaction, re-selects the
authoritative Agent with `FOR UPDATE`, re-reads its bindings, and only then resolves model/tool
state and allocates the next version number. If the authoritative draft gained a new LATEST
binding during the boundary, materialization is repeated before the Agent is locked again; no
pre-commit Agent or binding state is used for the immutable spec.

`resolved_spec_hash` is `canonical_json_hash(resolved_spec)`, including the schema version. The
Agent row is locked during version allocation, so concurrent publishes produce serial version
numbers rather than duplicate version numbers.

## API boundary

The minimal API supports Draft create/list/get/update, publish, and version listing under
`/api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/agents`. Request schemas forbid client-supplied workspace,
organization, creator, version, hash and secret fields. The existing `WorkspaceExecutionContext`
and `agent_create` / `agent_edit` permissions remain authoritative.

## Verification

- Unit coverage: canonical hash stability/change, model projection, configuration validation,
  ToolRevision hash, secret exclusion and capability mismatch.
- PostgreSQL integration: publish freeze, version 1/2 concurrency, cross-workspace ModelProfile,
  Snapshot and Tool foreign-key isolation, ToolRevision v2 immutability, and capability failure.
- PostgreSQL integration also covers concurrent LATEST materialization/publish and a deterministic
  draft change after materialization; both verify concrete snapshot IDs/hashes and no LATEST value
  in immutable specs.
- CI uses real PostgreSQL and runs `tests/integration/test_m4a_publish.py`; no provider adapter or
  public LLM is called.
- Final acceptance: GitHub Actions run #55 passed backend, frontend, and the M4-A integration step.

M4-B, Tool Runtime, LangGraph, Agent Run, streaming and Approval remain outside this milestone.

# M4-B — READ Tool Runtime

Status: PASS — closure verified in GitHub Actions run #59.

M4-B adds a bounded, provider-neutral READ Tool Runtime. It does not start LangGraph, create
AgentRun/RunStep persistence, stream model output, or implement Approval Runtime.

## Runtime contract

- `ToolRuntime.execute` starts from a published `AgentVersion.resolved_spec`.
- The exact published `tool_revision_id` and `tool_spec_hash` are loaded and verified before
  dispatch. Draft state, latest revisions, and mutable `Tool.name` are never dispatch inputs.
- Executable revisions are static `kind=builtin` definitions with an identity, JSON Schema,
  effect, risk, approval policy and bounded timeout. Older M4-A revisions may omit description
  and timeout; execution supplies safe defaults.
- Only `search_knowledge`, `calculator` and `query_customer` with `READ + NEVER` execute
  automatically. Other approval combinations return `TOOL_APPROVAL_NOT_AVAILABLE` without
  invoking a handler. Approval Runtime is M5 scope.
- Arguments use strict JSON Schema validation. Extra properties and workspace/organization/user
  or revision-scope injection keys are rejected.
- Results are explicitly `UNTRUSTED`. Handler errors, timeouts and unknown identities return
  safe error codes without raw exceptions, secrets or provider details.

## Builtins and tenancy

- `calculator` evaluates a bounded AST allowlist and never calls `eval`, a shell or imports.
- `query_customer` reads the new workspace-scoped `customers` and `tickets` tables. Tickets use
  a composite workspace/customer foreign key, so cross-workspace references fail in PostgreSQL.
- `search_knowledge` reuses the production `KnowledgeRetriever` contract, queries only concrete
  snapshots frozen in the published version, and returns a deterministic bounded projection.
  Tests inject a deterministic fake retriever; CI does not download BGE weights or call a public
  LLM.

## Audit and observability

Tool execution records only the safe `ToolAudit` projection through the existing `AuditLog`
model. Production audit writes use an independent session and audit failure is non-fatal.
The `tool.execute` span contains only tenant/version/tool identity, revision, decision, status,
duration, error code and argument keys. Tool trace failure is non-fatal.

## Verification

- Migration: `0008_m4b_tool_runtime`.
- Unit coverage validates policy and executable revision compatibility.
- PostgreSQL integration covers published calculator execution, unknown/unbound tools, strict
  arguments, injection rejection, approval semantics, old revisions, hash mismatch, customer
  tenant isolation, composite FK enforcement, viewer permission, timeout/audit/trace behavior,
  and snapshot-bound retriever injection.
- CI runs real PostgreSQL, Redis, Qdrant and Celery setup, then the dedicated
  `tests/integration/test_m4b_tool_runtime.py` step. No public tool execution endpoint is added.
- Implementation commit: `b305a58`
- Final closure commit: `8553c68`
- GitHub Actions run #59 passed backend, frontend, and M4-B integration.

M4-C Agent Run / LangGraph remains outside this milestone.

# M4-C — Agent Run + LangGraph Runtime

Status: PASS — closure verified in GitHub Actions run #62.

## Scope

M4-C adds a non-streaming Agent Run execution path over a real LangGraph `StateGraph`.
Only immutable, hash-verified `AgentVersion` records are executable. The runtime uses the
published model/tool projections, bounded READ tool execution, safe untrusted observations,
and short independent database transactions for `AgentRun` and `RunStep` history.

This milestone does not include streaming, ContextBudgetPolicy, durable LangGraph checkpoints,
interrupt/resume, ApprovalRequest persistence, Agent Builder UI, evaluation datasets, M4-D,
or M5.

## Frozen execution contract

The M2 gateway now exposes `generate_resolved()` for a `ResolvedModelExecutionPlan`. The
published primary and fallback profile identities, provider, model parameters, timeout,
capabilities and retry policy are read from the immutable version. The runtime loads only the
current secret by the frozen `credential_ref` and fails closed on missing, disabled, cross-
workspace or provider-mismatched credentials. Mutable ModelProfile edits do not change an old
run; secret rotation remains allowed.

## Runtime and persistence

The graph nodes are `prepare`, `model`, `tool_proposal`, `policy`, `read_execute`, `observation`
and `finish`, connected with `START`/`END`. M4-C permits only `RUNNING`, `SUCCEEDED` and `FAILED`;
approval-required tools fail with `TOOL_APPROVAL_NOT_AVAILABLE` and do not enter a waiting state.
Guard limits are persisted as safe step metadata, while prompt text, model output, tool
arguments/results, knowledge content, credentials and customer PII are excluded from `RunStep`.

Migration: `0009_m4c_agent_runtime`.

## Verification

The dedicated acceptance command is:


The test suite uses real PostgreSQL with deterministic fake model adapters and covers successful

limits, and workspace scoping. GitHub Actions runs this step after the existing M4-B integration

call is used.

# M5-A — Approval Runtime + Durable Approval Resume

Status: PASS — closure verified in GitHub Actions run #81.

Code closure commit: `b54cb4fef7c68c4fdc4555d059a70421d57a62a0`.
Run #81 passed backend, frontend, M5 integration, and M5 deterministic evaluation.

M5-A is limited to Approval, durable approval resume, one internal WRITE action, crash recovery,
and the minimum Approval UX. M5-B MCP and later milestones are not part of this record.

## State model

Approval decision and action execution are persisted as independent dimensions:

| Decision | Execution |
| --- | --- |
| `PENDING`, `APPROVED`, `DENIED`, `EXPIRED`, `CANCELLED` | `NOT_STARTED`, `CLAIMED`, `SUCCEEDED`, `FAILED`, `UNKNOWN_OUTCOME` |

`logical_action_id` is deterministic over the tenant, Run, published tool revision, canonical
argument hash, and proposal ordinal. It never uses a provider-generated `tool_call_id`.

Before an Approval is created, arguments are JSON-Schema validated, recursively checked for
server-owned fields, canonicalized, and hashed. Resume executes the persisted canonical
arguments; it does not trust arguments regenerated by a replayed model call.

## Action execution and safety semantics

M5-A implements only the internal transactional `create_ticket` WRITE action. Its idempotency key
is the persisted logical action identity and the database has a tenant-scoped uniqueness
constraint. Concurrent claims have one winner, and a committed result is reused on replay.

`UNKNOWN_OUTCOME` means the external side effect cannot be confirmed. It preserves
`decision_status=APPROVED`, sets the Run to `NEEDS_ATTENTION`, and is never automatically retried.
Approval decisions and action execution emit safe AuditLog/RunStep projections; raw arguments,
credentials, provider exceptions, and action payloads are excluded.

The runtime emits provider-neutral `approval.wait` and `approval.execute` spans with only safe
workspace/Run/Approval/action identity, status, latency, and failure-code attributes.

## Checkpoint ownership and durability boundary

AgentHub business tables are owned by Alembic migration `0012_m5_approval_runtime`. LangGraph
PostgreSQL checkpoint tables are framework-owned in the `langgraph_checkpoint` schema and are
created only by the explicit bootstrap command:

```powershell
uv run --locked python -m scripts.bootstrap_langgraph_checkpoint --database-url <database-url>
```

The stable checkpoint identity is tenant-safe and binds `workspace_id` to `run_id`. The accepted
durability guarantee is **durable approval resume**: a Run in `WAITING_APPROVAL` can survive page
refresh, browser close, API/runtime restart, and a later decision, then resume the same Run.
This does not claim token-level durable streaming, SSE replay, or exactly-once semantics for
arbitrary external actions.

## Crash-window recovery evidence

The M5-A PostgreSQL integration suite covers the required windows:

1. Action commit before graph resume: a persisted `SUCCEEDED` execution is consumed after
   recovery and the action executor is not called again; the ticket count remains one.
2. Approval exists without a checkpoint: reconciliation is explicit and fail-closed as
   `NEEDS_ATTENTION / APPROVAL_CHECKPOINT_MISSING`; repeating reconciliation is idempotent and
   does not create another Approval.
3. Checkpoint exists while the Run is still `RUNNING`: reconciliation restores
   `WAITING_APPROVAL`; repeating reconciliation leaves the durable state unchanged.

Additional integration coverage includes concurrent claim, effectively-once ticket creation,
double/resume replay, unknown outcome, waiting cancellation, expiry, and developer approval
authorization. The main approved flow creates one ticket, resumes the original `AgentRun.id`,
and completes after a newly instantiated runtime service.

## Evaluation

The independent deterministic M5 dataset is
`benchmarks/approval_runtime/dataset.json` (`m5-approval-runtime-v1`, 20 cases: 14 dev and
6 holdout). It covers approval required/denied/approved, duplicate approval, multi-step action,
self-approval denial, restart/resume, idempotent action, unknown outcome, cancel race, and crash
recovery. It uses no public LLM and records its canonical dataset hash and metrics in
`benchmarks/approval_runtime/results/m5-approval-runtime-v1.json`.

## Verification record

Local verification before final CI includes:

- real PostgreSQL Alembic upgrade/check and explicit LangGraph checkpoint bootstrap;
- M5 checkpoint round-trip integration;
- M5 approval runtime integration: 8 passed;
- fresh PostgreSQL integration matrix: 84 passed, 4 skipped;
- M5 deterministic evaluation: 20 / 20 passed;
- existing M4 benchmark remains 20 / 20;
- Ruff, non-integration pytest, frontend build, and Docker Compose config passed;
- bootstrap accepts the project `postgresql+asyncpg` configuration URL and routes framework
  tables to `langgraph_checkpoint`.

M5-B MCP, M6, and later milestones have not started.

# M6-A — Run Query, Run Detail and Timeline

Status: PASS — post-M5 review closure is verified on `m6/observability`, branched from the frozen M5-A
acceptance SHA `1e712dff4a8991eaa60fb39933ed7e00fc69bda6`.

M5-A remains a frozen contract during this milestone. M6-A adds a read-only observability query
surface without changing Approval state transitions, checkpoint identity, reconciliation, or
the `UNKNOWN_OUTCOME` / `NEEDS_ATTENTION` semantics.

## Query surface

The API exposes workspace-scoped safe projections at:

```text
GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/runs
GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/runs/{run_id}
GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/runs/{run_id}/steps
```

The list supports `status`, `agent_version_id`, `limit`, and an opaque created-at/id cursor. The
list query joins AgentVersion and aggregates Approval counts in one bounded query; it does not
perform per-run AgentVersion or Approval lookups.

Run detail includes identity, AgentVersion number and resolved spec hash, effective knowledge
snapshot identities, timestamps, model/tool counts, usage, cost, failure code/category, and an
approval summary. Raw prompts, model output, credentials, RAG/customer content, tool arguments or
results, and checkpoint payloads are not part of the projection.

## Timeline and failure presentation

The `/steps` response is a provider-neutral safe timeline assembled from RunStep and Approval
records. It exposes stable event kinds (`RUN_STARTED`, `MODEL`, `RETRIEVAL`, `TOOL`,
`APPROVAL_WAIT`, `APPROVAL_DECISION`, `ACTION_EXECUTION`, `RESUME`, `FINISH`, and `FAILURE`)
with ordering, status, bounded duration, safe metadata, and the original safe failure code.
LangGraph node names and checkpoint payloads are not returned.

Failure categories are presentation/query mappings only: `MODEL`, `KNOWLEDGE`, `TOOL`, `APPROVAL`,
`ACTION`, `RUNTIME`, `AUTH/TENANT`, and `UNKNOWN`. Stored failure codes remain unchanged.

## Frontend

The developer-facing `/runs` and `/runs/{run_id}` pages keep the access token in React state only.
They display status, AgentVersion, duration, usage, cost, tool calls, approval summary and the
safe timeline. `WAITING_APPROVAL` and `NEEDS_ATTENTION` have distinct operator-facing states;
approval decision failures are not presented as action execution failures.

## Verification target

Acceptance requires targeted M6-A integration coverage for workspace/RBAC isolation, viewer read,
pagination, safe projection, timeline ordering, approval-vs-action distinction, WAITING_APPROVAL,
NEEDS_ATTENTION, usage/cost, and a one-query run list. Existing M4 and M5 contracts and their
benchmarks remain unchanged and must continue to pass.

## Final verification

Implementation commit: `27086f7` (`feat: add M6-A run observability`).

Post-M5/M6 runtime closure commit: `2eb9b1f` (`fix: close M6 runtime review gaps`).

GitHub Actions run [#85](https://github.com/lijihao-0804/AgentHub/actions/runs/35422911503)
passed the backend and frontend jobs for the closure commit. Fresh PostgreSQL verification
upgraded through migration `0013_m6_operational_indexes`; Alembic drift checking and the
LangGraph checkpoint bootstrap passed. The final local verification recorded 88 integration
tests passed with 4 intentionally skipped Redis-only M3-B cases, and 226 non-integration tests
passed. M4 and M5 benchmark suites both passed 20/20. The retrieval dataset validation, frontend
build, and `docker compose config` also passed.

M5-A remains frozen at `1e712dff4a8991eaa60fb39933ed7e00fc69bda6`; no M5 state-machine or
historical migration was rewritten. M6-B and later milestones remain outside this acceptance.

# M6-B — Metrics, Dashboard and Failure Analytics

Status: PASS — metrics, dashboard and runtime-backed failure analytics are verified by
GitHub Actions run #90 at exact HEAD `a8b2e05`.

M6-B productizes the M6-A safe Run projections into workspace-scoped operational metrics. It
does not change M4 Agent Runtime, M5 Approval Runtime, checkpoint identity, or tool execution
semantics.

## API surface

The read-only API is:

```text
GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/observability/summary
GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/observability/timeseries
GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/observability/failures
GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/observability/agent-versions
```

All queries require workspace access and use a bounded UTC window. The default window is seven
days; the maximum is 90 days. Hourly buckets are limited to 48 hours. `agent_version_id` is an
optional filter where applicable.

## Frozen metric definitions

`finished_runs` is exactly `SUCCEEDED + FAILED + CANCELLED + NEEDS_ATTENTION`. It excludes
`RUNNING`, `WAITING_APPROVAL`, and `CANCEL_REQUESTED`.

Every rate returns `numerator`, `denominator`, and `rate`:

- `success_rate = SUCCEEDED / finished_runs`
- `failure_rate = FAILED / finished_runs`
- `cancelled_rate = CANCELLED / finished_runs`
- `needs_attention_rate = NEEDS_ATTENTION / finished_runs`

Zero denominators return `null`, never a fabricated zero or `NaN`. Current-state counters are
separate from window rates. `unknown_outcome_action_count` comes from Approval
`execution_status = UNKNOWN_OUTCOME`, not from guessing from Run failure codes.

Latency uses only Runs with both `started_at` and `completed_at`; active Runs never enter the
distribution. PostgreSQL `percentile_cont` provides p50/p95 and the response includes
`sample_count`.

Usage separates known from unknown totals. Missing usage is not converted to zero.

Costs are grouped by currency. USD, EUR, or any other currencies are never added together.
`cost_per_successful_run` uses only successful Runs with known cost and returns its denominator.
Estimated and exact counts remain separate; absent cost is `null`.

Approval metrics keep decision state and action execution state distinct and report pending,
approved, denied, expired, cancelled, claimed, succeeded, failed and unknown outcomes, plus
approval wait p50/p95 over approvals with `decided_at`.

## Failure and AgentVersion analytics

Failure categories reuse the M6-A presentation taxonomy: `MODEL`, `KNOWLEDGE`, `TOOL`,
`APPROVAL`, `ACTION`, `RUNTIME`, `AUTH/TENANT`, and `UNKNOWN`. Each category retains bounded
top raw safe failure codes and the failure list preserves the safe action identity fields needed
for `UNKNOWN_OUTCOME` diagnosis without exposing arguments or results.

AgentVersion breakdown is descriptive only: run count, success/failed/needs-attention counts,
p95 latency, average known tokens, and currency-grouped cost. It does not rank versions or claim
an experiment result.

Timeseries uses fixed PostgreSQL UTC day/hour buckets and reports runs, succeeded, failed,
needs-attention, known tokens and currency-grouped cost.

## Dashboard and drill-down

`/dashboard` provides summary cards, current operational state, trend rows, failure categories,
currency-safe costs, AgentVersion breakdown and bounded failure Runs. Failure category selection
reloads the failure API; Run and AgentVersion links preserve filters through URL query parameters.
The existing Runs and Run Detail pages remain the safe drill-down surface.

The developer-facing access token remains React-state-only. No token is written to localStorage,
sessionStorage, cookies, URLs, API bodies, or logs.

## Failure scenario dataset

`benchmarks/observability/dataset.json` contains 10 bounded synthetic failure scenarios covering
model, stream/runtime, tool, knowledge, loop guard, approval decision, action failure,
unknown-outcome, missing checkpoint and cancellation paths. The integration test
`tests/integration/test_m6b_failure_dataset_runtime.py` executes every case through the real
`AgentRunService`, `ToolRuntime`, Approval Runtime and PostgreSQL, then reads the resulting
safe `AgentRun`/`RunStep` evidence. It does not insert hand-written Run rows. The CI validation
step checks the manifest envelope, and the runtime step checks the generated durable evidence.

No prompt, credential, customer record, raw tool payload, or checkpoint body is committed.

## Performance and safety

Metrics are PostgreSQL aggregates with workspace/time indexes from migration
`0014_m6_metrics_indexes`; the API does not load all Runs into Python and does not perform
per-Run detail queries. All dashboard projections remain provider-neutral and content-redacted.
TraceSink availability is not a metrics dependency; PostgreSQL is the source of truth and the
production TraceSink remains fail-open.

M6-B is accepted. M6 overall is accepted after M6-A and M6-B. M7 is not started.

# M7-A — Evaluation Dataset and Pricing Snapshot

Status: PASS — closure verified by GitHub Actions run #92 at exact HEAD
`0d4fdc6d06c7156c583cae67bad5d61a20bf0153`.

M7-A establishes the immutable inputs needed for reproducible evaluation. It does not run
experiments, invoke providers, expose holdout results, or implement release gates.

## Dataset contract

Datasets are workspace-scoped. Each dataset version is a numbered immutable candidate with a
canonical SHA-256 `content_hash` over its schema version and normalized items. Versions begin as
`DRAFT` and may be published once; a published version cannot be published again or treated as
mutable input.

Every item has an explicit `case_key`, `split` (`DEV` or `HOLDOUT`), category, typed input and
expected fields, tags, source provenance, and ordinal. M7-A validates the category shapes for
retrieval, knowledge QA, tool, no-answer, approval, multi-step, and failure cases. Duplicate
case keys, normalized inputs, expected identities, source provenance, and ordinals are rejected.
Secret-like keys are rejected recursively. Dataset validation is deterministic and does not mutate
caller input.

The PostgreSQL tables are owned by migration `0015_m7_evaluation_platform`; migrations `0001`
through `0014` remain unchanged. All reads and writes require a workspace-scoped execution
context. Developers and organization administrators may manage evaluation inputs; viewers may
read them within their workspace.

## Pricing contract

`PricingSnapshot` records provider/model pricing as an immutable, workspace-scoped snapshot. Prices
are stored as `NUMERIC(20, 8)` and accepted only as non-negative decimal values with at most eight
fractional digits. The canonical content hash uses normalized decimal strings, timezone-aware
`effective_at`, and the complete pricing metadata; it never hashes a binary float.

Pricing is synthetic or operator-provided in M7-A. It is not a claim of current provider billing
and is not yet bound to an experiment until the later experiment persistence milestone.

## Verification

- M7-A unit validation: 7 passed.
- M7-A PostgreSQL integration: 3 passed.
- Alembic upgraded to `0015_m7_evaluation_platform`; `alembic check` passed.
- GitHub Actions run #92 passed backend, frontend, M7-A integration, and the existing
  non-integration checks.
- No BGE weights, public LLM, or real provider calls are required.

M7-A is accepted. M7-B persistence/reproducibility is the next milestone; M7 overall is not
accepted.

# M7-B — Experiment Persistence and Reproducibility Freeze

Status: PASS

M7-B persists formal evaluation definitions and queued run identities. It does not execute
dataset cases, start Celery work, calculate metrics, or implement ablation/release gates.

## Experiment contract

An `EvaluationExperiment` is created as `DRAFT` only from a published, workspace-scoped
`EvaluationDatasetVersion`. It freezes the dataset version, content hash, schema version, split,
purpose, repetition count, build SHA, and evaluator manifest. Finalization validates every
variant and writes a canonical `spec_json` plus `spec_hash`; a `READY` experiment has no mutation
API and is the reproducibility boundary.

Each `EvaluationExperimentVariant` stores the immutable AgentVersion identity and
`resolved_spec_hash`, a workspace-scoped PricingSnapshot and its content hash, safe variant
metadata, effective knowledge snapshots, and a behavior-oriented `variant_hash`. Provider and
model names must match the pricing snapshot. Secrets, prompts, checkpoint payloads, and customer
content are not copied into the experiment record.

`LATEST` knowledge bindings are resolved once while the variant is created. The persisted
`knowledge_base_id`, `binding_mode`, `snapshot_id`, and `snapshot_content_hash` are then used for
the variant and are never re-resolved from the current knowledge base.

## Queued runs and holdout audit

`EvaluationExperimentRun` is a separate execution record. M7-B creates only `QUEUED` runs and
copies the build SHA, dataset hash, experiment `spec_hash`, split, purpose, and repetitions. It
does not enqueue or execute a case.

Creating a `HOLDOUT` run records an append-only, workspace-scoped exposure with a monotonic
dataset-version index. Development runs do not create holdout exposures, and experiment detail
and run responses expose the current exposure index/count.

## Verification

- Migration `0016_m7_experiment_persistence` adds tenant-safe experiment, variant, run, and
  holdout-exposure tables. Migrations `0001` through `0015` remain unchanged.
- Build identity is supplied by `AGENTHUB_BUILD_SHA` or the infrastructure Git adapter; formal
  experiments reject an unknown identity.
- Evaluator versions are recorded in a canonical manifest for later M7 evaluator implementations.
- Implementation SHA: `8fa153aebbecf6c4dde42ae4a828028d987f4ac8`.
- Migration `0016_m7_experiment_persistence`: Alembic upgrade and drift check passed.
- Targeted M7-B PostgreSQL and unit/API verification passed (`27 passed`, 2 warnings), including
  duplicate-definition rejection, run-only permission scope, and frozen `LATEST` knowledge.
- M7-A regression passed as part of the targeted verification.
- Non-integration regression passed (`245 passed`, `105 deselected`).
- Ruff passed.
- Frontend build passed in GitHub Actions.
- GitHub Actions CI `#94` passed the implementation commit with backend and frontend jobs green.
- The full local infrastructure matrix was not run because local PostgreSQL/Qdrant services were
  unavailable; this was an infrastructure availability limitation, not a code failure.

The M7-B contract is complete: `Experiment`, `ExperimentVariant`, `ExperimentRun`, canonical
`spec_json`/`spec_hash`, `variant_hash`, one-time `LATEST` knowledge freeze, PricingSnapshot
binding, build SHA, evaluator manifest, append-only HOLDOUT exposure, and `READY` immutability.

# M7-C — Durable Experiment Runner

Status: PASS — implementation and independent-review closure are complete; exact-head CI is
the final remote verification gate.

M7-C executes the frozen M7-B experiment definition as a durable database-backed case
matrix. Celery transports only the `experiment_run_id`; workers rebuild the deterministic
dataset-item × variant × repetition plan from PostgreSQL.

## Durable execution contract

`EvaluationExperimentCaseResult` is unique by workspace, run, variant, dataset item, and
repetition index. Runs use an atomic lease claim, bounded reconciliation, a bounded heartbeat
during long cases, lease generations, and database-derived progress. Duplicate delivery can
therefore produce at most one active worker for a run, while stale leases can be reclaimed
without allowing a late worker to persist results.

Terminal case results are skipped on resume. A CaseResult is linked to its durable AgentRun
before graph execution; a linked terminal AgentRun is projected into the existing case result
rather than creating a second AgentRun. Missing or non-terminal links fail closed during
recovery.

Cancellation is durable: RUNNING becomes `CANCEL_REQUESTED`, no new cases are claimed, and
remaining PENDING cases become `CANCELLED`. Queue failures leave the persisted run QUEUED for
reconciliation.

Case observations are safe projections. Raw prompts, customer data, RAG text, tool results,
credentials, and checkpoint payloads are not persisted by the runner. Cost is recalculated
from the variant's frozen PricingSnapshot when all required usage is available, including
cached-input pricing; missing usage leaves cost null. Expected Agent failures are retained as
observed-agent fields and do not make the evaluation runner fail.

Production worker composition delegates TOOL, APPROVAL, KNOWLEDGE_QA, NO_ANSWER, MULTI_STEP,
and FAILURE cases to AgentRunService and uses the formal retrieval contract for RETRIEVAL cases.
The deterministic driver is injected only by the explicit testing composition. Frozen LATEST
knowledge bindings are passed through a trusted internal AgentRun preparation contract and
validated again at execution time; execution never re-resolves LATEST. Evaluation approval
decisions use a server-resolved OWNER/ADMIN operator through the normal ApprovalService. Safe
evaluation run/case trace spans are fail-open and contain no business content.

# M7-D — Evaluators, Metrics, and Paired Comparison

Status: PASS — closure verified in GitHub Actions run #115.

M7-D consumes the immutable M7-B experiment definition and persisted M7-C CaseResults. It does
not re-run Agents, reinterpret AgentRun state, or change M5 approval/checkpoint semantics.

## Evaluation contract

`MetricValue` is JSON-serializable and always carries one of `AVAILABLE`, `NOT_APPLICABLE`, or
`NOT_AVAILABLE`. Empty ground truth, missing structured observations, unknown usage, and missing
cost data are represented explicitly rather than as fabricated zeros. Evaluator versions are
validated against the experiment's frozen manifest; incompatible or incomplete manifests fail
closed with `EXPERIMENT_EVALUATOR_VERSION_MISMATCH`.

The registry currently provides deterministic v1 evaluators for retrieval, knowledge QA,
tool-use, no-answer, approval, multi-step, and expected-failure cases. Retrieval uses the
existing provider-neutral Recall@20, Recall@5, and MRR@5 definitions. Citation precision and
coverage, accepted structured answers, strict canonical tool arguments, approval safety
semantics, and observation-based task success are included where the dataset supplies the
required signals. Faithfulness remains explicitly unavailable without a structured evidence
signal.

Latency percentiles use deterministic interpolation. Usage is reported with known/unknown
counts, cached tokens are retained separately, and costs are grouped by currency; mixed
currencies are never summed. Repetition statistics are aggregated by dataset item before the
overall mean/stddev is calculated. Failure rates exclude expected Agent failures and count only
runner failures. Category and variant dimensions are persisted in PostgreSQL.

## Paired comparison

Comparisons pair baseline and candidate results by `(dataset_item_id, repetition_index)`. The
result records COMPLETE, INCOMPLETE, or NOT_COMPARABLE, including missing pairs, absolute and
relative deltas, direction-aware wins/ties/losses, and evaluator versions. A zero baseline has
no fabricated relative delta.

The API exposes workspace-scoped metrics and comparison queries under:

- `GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/evaluation/experiment-runs/{run_id}/metrics`
- `POST /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/evaluation/experiment-runs/{run_id}/comparisons`

Only safe persisted projections are returned. Raw prompts, customer content, credentials,
checkpoint payloads, and raw tool arguments/results are not introduced by M7-D.
